entities.summary: Charles Miller Sheaffer, Jr., also known as "Juney" Sheaffer, was an American field hockey player who played in the position of forward. He competed in the 1932 Summer Olympics and 1936 Summer Olympics, and was a member of the United States field hockey team that won the bronze medal in Los Angeles in 1932. A native of Pennsylvania, he was one of eight players from the Quakers field hockey club which played at the Philadelphia cricket club, to be selected for the 1932 US line-up.
